Definition: from G1537 and G5399; to frighten utterly:--terrify.
BiblicalUsage: ekphobéō means terrify. In 2 Corinthians 10:9, the text says "That I may not seem as if I would terrify you by letters."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, ekphobéō means terrify, nothing more and nothing less.
